narrative.northStar: White Paper on a Butter Desk
narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "White Paper on a Butter Desk"**

Assessly uses the SiteNest "Butter" design system, shared with Aemora: white paper on a pale butter desk, butter hairlines and one amber accent. Desk (`desk`, #fcfaf3) is the chrome; paper (white) is what people work with. Amber (`accent`, #e8b923) is a fill that marks what is actionable or selected, and is never text; accent-coloured text is ochre (`accent-text`, #826400). Newsreader carries headlines, DM Sans carries everything else. Light and dark themes are both first class, with a toggle and no system option.
keyCharacteristics: One amber voice: a fill, never text. Text on amber is charcoal; accent text is ochre.
Newsreader 500 for every h1 and h2, enforced by one unlayered rule; DM Sans 600 for titles, labels and buttons.
Paper (white) on desk (pale butter) with butter hairlines; flat pages, with lift only on hover for clickable cards, drawers and the device mockup.
Every button a pill; fields 8px; menus 12px; cards 20px. Selection is amber tint, hover is sand, never grey.
Light and dark themes with a pill toggle (light default, no system option); dark is a warm charcoal ramp.
Short numeric inputs, select boxes that show labels, and an image field that states its limits and accepts pasted screenshots.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Terracotta is the only accent. It marks the primary action, the focus state and the brand mark; it is never a second decorative colour next to blues or greens.

rules.name: The Cream Chrome Rule
rules.body: Chrome is `surface` (teacher sidebar, student page ground, footers); working surfaces are white. A card on a white teacher page is separated by its hairline border and faint shadow, so cards always carry both. Never hardcode a cream hex: use `bg-surface` / `var(--surface)`.

rules.name: The Token Only Rule
rules.body: No literal `#C74504`, `#FFF9EB` or `bg-white` in components. Use `primary`, `surface`, `card`, `popover` so dark mode and future re-theming hold.

rules.name: The Weight Not Size Rule
rules.body: Emphasis comes from weight and `ink` vs `ink-muted`; there is no fluid type and no tier above Display.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Scores, marks, counts and timers are numbers people compare; give them `tabular-nums`.

rules.name: The Quiet Elevation Rule
rules.body: Rows, badges and inputs have no resting shadow; cards carry only the faint `shadow-card`. Real lift belongs to hover, the dropdown, the drawer and the device mockup.

dos: **Do** use `bg-surface` for chrome (sidebar, student page, footers) and `bg-card` for cards, forms, selects and popovers.
**Do** keep terracotta to the primary action, focus, the mark and one emphasis phrase per view.
**Do** separate surfaces with 1px hairlines (#e8ddc8) and tone, and keep resting surfaces shadowless.

**Do** open create, edit, preview and details flows in a right-hand drawer with the shared overlay, 300ms slide and header pattern, mounted through `Portal` so a transformed card or page can never trap it.
**Do** keep lists scalable: search, grouping, and a capped first page with "show more" or "+N more" instead of an ever-longer list.
**Do** put a breadcrumb trail above the title on every drilled-down teacher page.
**Do** use `tabular-nums` for scores, marks, counts and timers.
**Do** keep white text on any tinted photo behind a scrim that guarantees 4.5:1.
donts: **Don't** write a literal brand hex, `bg-white`, or a hardcoded cream in components; use tokens.
**Don't** put a second accent colour next to terracotta for decoration.
**Don't** add a shadow to rows, badges or inputs at rest, or put a transform on a page-level wrapper (it traps `position: fixed` drawers); page transitions are opacity only.
**Don't** build a view whose size is students times tests; show queues and per-entity details instead.
**Don't** split student sign-in into the photograph layout; it stays a single centred card.
**Don't** use neutral grey for dark mode; use the warm brown-black ramp.
**Don't** invent copy or statistics in the dashboard mockup beyond clearly labelled sample data.
